title: [Quality Management] Quality Inspection User assignment fixes
summary: Fixes a table relation error when manually selecting an assigned user on a quality inspection, and shows a self-assignment notification when modifying an inspection that has no assigned user.
key_points: Manually selecting an assigned user no longer raises a table relation error
Modifying an unassigned quality inspection now prompts a self-assignment notification
Changes in Qlty. Inspection Header table and Qlty. Permission Mgmt. codeunit
Tests for user assignment added to the misc test codeunit, with some tests moved out of the test table codeunit
quote: Resolved a table relation error that occurred when manually selecting an assigned user.
